original_test_intent: Install an approved older BIOS and prove downgrade support, target version, preserved configuration and healthy host recovery.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: The row's WebUI text says start firmware upgrade although the item requires BIOS downgrade.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Approved older version becomes active and platform configuration/health remain acceptable.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with anti-rollback, ordered-version path and per-hop evidence.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer confirms downgrade support and operates the supported path; agent may assist evidence and task monitoring.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: BIOS downgrade through the source WebUI flow; procedure wording still says upgrade.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Vendor-supported downgrade path, anti-rollback policy, ordered image sequence, per-hop gates, settings/security state, rollback and approval.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Direct versus staged downgrade and preserved settings must be explicit.

original_method: The original WebUI text and downgrade item are both preserved as a source discrepancy.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Follow the exact board vendor's supported downgrade procedure and version path; do not infer that the ordinary upgrade API permits downgrade.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Every source, intermediate and target version must be supported.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds required policy/path validation; does not redefine downgrade as upgrade.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Each hop requires activation, boot, security, configuration and inventory evidence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Version path, signed images, anti-rollback and per-hop gates.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported downgrade may brick, reset settings or violate security policy.

missing_inputs: Vendor-approved downgrade path and anti-rollback policy
safety_boundaries: Do not bypass signature or anti-rollback
No forced incompatible image, power interruption or automatic retry
No assumption that preserve-all is cross-version safe
no_automatic_retry: Any failed hop stops; retry or recovery requires approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: BIOS/security engineer owns each transition and final verdict.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already treated the upgrade wording as a real case-specific discrepancy and required downgrade-specific security evidence.
